### MongoSQL ODBC Driver

- **MongoSQL ODBC Driver** · self — The MongoSQL ODBC driver is a 64-bit Unicode driver for Atlas SQL connectivity; the Power BI MongoDB Atlas SQL connector requires this native driver. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-odbc-driver
